city_name: Angra dos Reis + Ilha Grande (Costa Verde)
note: Densification pass 2026-07. All coordinates verified against OpenStreetMap (Overpass API, node/way IDs cited) cross-checked with operator/official pages. atlas_bp_id given where the point already exists on the live Atlas.

boarding_points.name: Estação Santa Luzia (Cais de Santa Luzia)
boarding_points.operator: Barcas Rio (state ferry) + licensed flexboat operators
boarding_points.notes: Main Angra passenger head: Barcas Rio Angra–Ilha Grande ferry (R$20.50, up to 110 min) and flexboats to Abraão (~40 min, ~6x/day), Araçatiba and Praia Vermelha (3x/day). Sealed Navier corridor endpoint. atlas_bp_id: bp-dbf5302ce6.

boarding_points.name: Cais da Lapa (Cais de Turismo)
boarding_points.notes: Tourism pier next to the town centre; departure point for schooner/lancha island circuits (Cataguás, Gipóia, Botinas). atlas_bp_id: bp-ff2a6bbcaf.

boarding_points.name: Estação Abraão (Cais de Turismo, Vila do Abraão)
boarding_points.operator: Flexboat/catamaran operators (Top Transfer, Objetiva, Vila Nova Tour et al.)
boarding_points.notes: Main tourist pier of car-free Vila do Abraão; arrival point for flexboats from Conceição de Jacareí, Angra and Mangaratiba; taxi-boat hub for island beaches. atlas_bp_id: bp-cbc264d32e.

boarding_points.name: Cais das Barcas (Vila do Abraão)
boarding_points.notes: State ferry pier at Abraão serving the Angra–Ilha Grande and Mangaratiba–Ilha Grande lines (R$20.50). Sealed Navier corridor endpoint on the island side. atlas_bp_id: bp-2b61ecbd63.
boarding_points.source: OSM way/85569784 'Cais das Barcas' + node/97331459 + barcasrio.com.br

boarding_points.name: Cais de Conceição de Jacareí
boarding_points.notes: Busiest tourist gateway to Ilha Grande: closest mainland point to Abraão (15–20 min flexboat), right off the BR-101 with paid parking. Embarkation tax R$10.30/leg (Mangaratiba Decreto 12.911/2023).
boarding_points.source: OSM way/262137460 'Conceição de Jacareí' + node/2677832841 + transladosconceicao.com.br + travessiailhagrande.com

boarding_points.name: Marina Porto Real (Conceição de Jacareí)
boarding_points.operator: Marina Porto Real / Top Transfer Brasil
boarding_points.notes: Private marina at Conceição de Jacareí used as scheduled flexboat departure (4x/day to Abraão, 15–20 min). NOTE: this is the Conceição de Jacareí marina, not a resort marina near Frade. atlas_bp_id: bp-e14c87a59b.
boarding_points.source: OSM node/6069296015 (marina) + travessiailhagrande.com ('Nossa travessia saindo da Marina do Porto Real')

boarding_points.name: Terminal Hidroviário de Mangaratiba
boarding_points.notes: Rio-side ferry head for Ilha Grande: Barcas Rio Mangaratiba–Abraão line (R$20.50, up to 110 min) plus flexboats (~40 min, 2x/day). Operator is Barcas Rio consortium since Feb 2025 (ex-CCR Barcas). atlas_bp_id: bp-314021f599 (also rendered as bp-f032d26f15 in the Rio market).

boarding_points.name: BR Marinas Piratas
boarding_points.notes: Large private marina beside Shopping Piratas on the Estrada das Marinas corridor; core leisure-fleet base for the bay. atlas_bp_id: bp-fab414c778.
boarding_points.source: OSM node/12077555376 (marina, adj. 'Shopping Piratas' node/12077555375) + brmarinas.com.br

boarding_points.name: BR Marinas Verolme
boarding_points.notes: Marina at the former Verolme yard in Jacuecanga bay; superyacht-capable berths. atlas_bp_id: bp-084bb4769a (also bp-2ec5282b48 in the Rio market view).

boarding_points.name: BR Marinas Ribeira
boarding_points.notes: Marina north of Angra centro on the Ribeira shore. atlas_bp_id: bp-6b6d60be5a.

boarding_points.name: Marina Portogalo
boarding_points.notes: Condominium marina on the headland between Angra and Conceição de Jacareí. Coordinates from unnamed OSM marina way matching the live Atlas node within ~60 m. atlas_bp_id: bp-2a8b4c18ce.
boarding_points.source: OSM way/1102380382 (marina) cross-checked vs Atlas bp-2a8b4c18ce

boarding_points.name: Marina Porto Frade
boarding_points.notes: Canal-marina community at Frade on the western shore of the bay; major leisure-fleet base for the Frade/Bracuhy side.
boarding_points.source: OSM way/424849993 'Porto Frade' + way/526850547 'Praia do Condomínio Porto Frade'

boarding_points.name: Marina Porto Bracuhy
boarding_points.notes: Marina at the Bracuí river mouth (Enseada do Bracuhy). Coordinate is an unnamed OSM marina node cross-checked against 'Enseada do Bracuhy' (node/9963063830) and 'Condomínio Porto Bracuhy' (node/5800003631); medium confidence on exact berth. atlas_bp_id: bp-09788b5387 (Marina Bracuhy JL).

boarding_points.name: Ilha de Cataguás (beach anchorage)
boarding_points.notes: Postcard white-sand islet on every Angra schooner circuit; beach/anchor landing only. Coordinates carried over from the live Atlas node. atlas_bp_id: bp-4144bf26ee.
boarding_points.source: Atlas bp-4144bf26ee (existing live node); tour evidence: angradosreisturismo.com.br

boarding_points.name: Ilha da Gipóia — Praia do Dentista
boarding_points.operator: Taxi boats and day charters (beach landing, no fixed pier)
boarding_points.notes: The bay's most famous boat-party beach on Ilha da Gipóia, reached only by boat from Angra. Beach/anchor landing; coordinate is the OSM-mapped beach point.
boarding_points.source: OSM node/5238746321 'Praia do Dentista' + island node/97... 'Ilha da Gipóia' (-23.0514,-44.3544)

boarding_points.name: Lagoa Azul (Ilha Grande, anchorage)
boarding_points.operator: Daily lancha/schooner tours from Abraão (anchorage, no pier)
boarding_points.notes: Turquoise snorkelling lagoon between islets off Ilha Grande's north coast; anchor-only stop on the classic half-day tour. No fixed infrastructure — coordinates are the OSM attraction point.

boarding_points.name: Praia de Japariz (Ilha Grande)
boarding_points.operator: Schooner tours (beach restaurants; small landing stage)
boarding_points.notes: Classic lunch stop of the Lagoa Azul tour circuit; boats beach or use restaurant landing stages.

boarding_points.name: Saco do Céu (Ilha Grande)
boarding_points.operator: Tour boats and yacht anchorage; waterfront restaurants with landings
boarding_points.notes: Fjord-like sheltered inlet ('Sack of the Sky') with famous waterfront restaurants; a signature overnight yacht anchorage of the bay.

boarding_points.name: Praia do Pouso (gateway to Lopes Mendes)
boarding_points.notes: Taxi-boat landing for Lopes Mendes — routinely ranked among Brazil's best beaches and reachable only via Pouso + 20-min trail (surf beach, no boat landing at Lopes Mendes itself). OSM maps the Abraão–Pouso/Lopes Mendes boat route (way/83561389).
boarding_points.source: OSM way/85571406 'Pouso' (beach) + route way/83561389 'Abraão - Pouso / Lopes Mendes'

boarding_points.name: Araçatiba (Ilha Grande)
boarding_points.notes: West-coast village in the Enseada de Araçatiba with scheduled 20–30 min lancha service from Angra's Cais de Santa Luzia; pousada cluster.
boarding_points.source: OSM node/416645309 'Praia de Araçatiba' (village) + travessiailhagrande.com schedules

boarding_points.name: Praia Vermelha (Ilha Grande)
boarding_points.operator: Scheduled lanchas from Angra (30–40 min, shared with Araçatiba service)
boarding_points.notes: Small hamlet served by the Angra–Araçatiba–Praia Vermelha scheduled lancha; pousada-anchored demand.
